import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'survived': [0, 1, 1, 1, 0],
    'pclass': [3, 1, 3, 1, 3],
    'sex': ['male', 'female', 'female', 'female', 'male'],
    'age': [22.0, 38.0, 26.0, 35.0, 35.0],
    'sibsp': [1, 1, 0, 1, 0],
    'parch': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'fare': [7.25, 71.2833, 7.925, 53.1, 8.05],
    'embarked': ['S', 'C', 'S', 'S', 'S'],
    'class': ['Third', 'First', 'Third', 'First', 'Third'],
    'who': ['man', 'woman', 'woman', 'woman', 'man'],
    'adult_male': [True, False, False, False, True],
    'deck': ['', 'C', '', 'C', ''],
    'embark_town': ['Southampton', 'Cherbourg', 'Southampton', 'Southampton', 'Southampton'],
    'alive': ['no', 'yes', 'yes', 'yes', 'no'],
    'alone': [False, False, True, False, True]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set up the visualization
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival by class and sex
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
survival_data = df.groupby(['class', 'sex', 'alive']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
survival_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax1.set_title('Survival by Class and Sex')
ax1.set_xlabel('Class & Sex')
ax1.set_ylabel('Count')
ax1.legend(title='Alive', labels=['No', 'Yes'])
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Age distribution by survival
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
age_bins = np.arange(0, 80, 5)
for alive_status in ['yes', 'no']:
    subset = df[df['alive'] == alive_status]['age'].dropna()
    ax2.hist(subset, bins=age_bins, alpha=0.6, label=alive_status, 
             color='#2ecc71' if alive_status == 'yes' else '#e74c3c')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax2.legend(title='Survived')

# 3. Fare distribution by class
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
class_order = ['First', 'Third']
fare_data = [df[df['class'] == cls]['fare'].dropna() for cls in class_order]
box = ax3.boxplot(fare_data, labels=class_order, patch_artist=True)
colors = ['#3498db', '#e67e22']
for patch, color in zip(box['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
ax3.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class')
ax3.set_ylabel('Fare')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Survival rate by embarkation town
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
embark_survival = df.groupby('embark_town')['alive'].apply(
    lambda x: (x == 'yes').sum() / len(x) * 100
).sort_values()
bars = ax4.bar(range(len(embark_survival)), embark_survival.values, 
               color=['#9b59b6', '#1abc9c'])
ax4.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Town')
ax4.set_xlabel('Embarkation Town')
ax4.set_ylabel('Survival Rate (%)')
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(embark_survival)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(embark_survival.index, rotation=45)
for i, v in enumerate(embark_survival.values):
    ax4.text(i, v + 1, f'{v:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom')

# 5. Family size vs survival
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['alive'].apply(
    lambda x: (x == 'yes').mean() * 100
)
ax5.scatter(family_survival.index, family_survival.values, s=100, 
            c=family_survival.values, cmap='RdYlGn', edgecolors='black')
ax5.set_title('Family Size vs Survival Rate')
ax5.set_xlabel('Family Size')
ax5.set_ylabel('Survival Rate (%)')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Passenger composition
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
composition = df['who'].value_counts()
colors = ['#3498db', '#e74c3c', '#2ecc71']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax6.pie(composition.values, labels=composition.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax6.set_title('Passenger Composition')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
